evals.prompt: Initialize a new TODO.md agile board file with the standard four Kanban sections and add a user story for CSV export.
evals.expected_output: A valid TODO.md file containing Backlog, Selected for Development, In Progress, and Done sections, with the user story placed in Backlog.
assertions: Defines the 4 canonical Kanban headers (Backlog, Selected for Development, In Progress, Done)
Places the newly drafted user story under the Backlog section
Story adheres to As a / I want / So that format with markdown checkbox acceptance criteria

evals.prompt: Advance the CSV export story in TODO.md from Selected for Development to Done after checking off all acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: Updated TODO.md with checked boxes [x] for the story's criteria and the story relocated under the Done section.
assertions: Moves the completed story block into the Done section
Removes or clears the story from the prior section
